title: PyTorch CUDA13 Binary Cannot Be Built with SM_75 with NVSHMEM
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Exposed by @tinglvv 's PR: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/160956#issuecomment-3201170469
@atalman noticed the  failure with cuda 13.0: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/actions/runs/17071609837/job/48401898961?pr=160956#step:16:9206

@Aidyn-A noticed that the support for Turing (sm_75) somehow is broken, with undefined reference errors   like these: 

```
caffe2/CMakeFiles/torch_nvshmem.dir/cmake_device_link.o -L/usr/local/cuda/targets/x86_64-linux/lib/stubs  -L/usr/local/cuda/targets/x86_64-linux/lib /usr/local/cuda/lib64/libnvshmem_device.a -lcudadevrt -lcudart_static -lrt -lpthread -ldl
